evidence: Alters CScriptWitness storage, transaction primitives in src/primitives/transaction.h, and block validation deserialization in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Resolves a reported vulnerability where worst-case valid 4 MB blocks with millions of small witness elements consume over 180 MiB of peak RAM and hundreds of milliseconds to deserialize. Benchmarks demonstrate that persisting witness stacks in serialized wire form drops worst-case deserialization from 279 ms to 19 ms, peak memory from 182 MiB to 7.8 MiB, and persisted memory from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB.
